headline: Sharks’ Alex Wennberg activated off IR, will return to lineup
take:
Daily Faceoff reports that the Sharks have activated Alex Wennberg off injured reserve, and he will return to the lineup. He has been out since October with an upper-body injury, per the outlet.

San Jose could use the help. The Sharks are 7-11-1 and have taken 42.3% of the expected goals so far this season (expected goals measure the quality of chances, so that is a below-average share). At five-on-five it is 44%, which says the problem is in the everyday game, not just special teams. The power play generates 0.68 expected goals per game, and the penalty kill allows 1.06. They have also scored 9.5 fewer goals than their chances would suggest, while their goaltending has saved 9.1 more than expected. So the goalies are covering for a team that is being outplayed and not finishing. We can't say from this data what Wennberg specifically adds, but any player who helps tilt the chance share toward San Jose is worth watching on his return.
